evals.name: api-hook-and-source-file
evals.prompt: I want server code to run whenever a car engine starts. which vanilla method on Car do I hook, with its exact signature, which file in scripts.pbo declares Car, and how do I read just that file from the installed game on Linux without extracting everything?
evals.expected_output: Names Car.OnEngineStart with signature void OnEngineStart(); Names the declaring file as 3_Game\Vehicles\Car.c (3_Game layer) inside dta/scripts.pbo; Uses armake2 cat on scripts.pbo for that single file instead of unpacking the whole PBO
assertions: Names Car.OnEngineStart with signature void OnEngineStart()
Names the declaring file as 3_Game\Vehicles\Car.c (3_Game layer) inside dta/scripts.pbo
Uses armake2 cat on scripts.pbo for that single file instead of unpacking the whole PBO

evals.name: extract-code-only

evals.expected_output: Identifies <DayZ install>/dta/scripts.pbo as the script PBO; Uses armake2 (inspect/cat or the bundled extract-dayz-sources.sh), not extractpbo or unpack of every addon; Extracts only code files (*.c etc.), not models or textures; Writes the output under /tmp or /var/tmp, not below $HOME; Does not follow the @workshop symlinks in the install dir
assertions: Identifies <DayZ install>/dta/scripts.pbo as the script PBO
Uses armake2 (inspect/cat or the bundled extract-dayz-sources.sh), not extractpbo or unpack of every addon
Extracts only code files (*.c etc.), not models or textures
Writes the output under /tmp or /var/tmp, not below $HOME
Does not follow the @workshop symlinks in the install dir
